sources_note.fr: Compilé à partir des sites officiels du département de la Défense et des armées américaines (.mil, .edu), complétés par Wikipédia. Bases renommées : en 2025, l'US Army a rétabli les noms Fort Bragg (ex-Fort Liberty), Fort Benning (ex-Fort Moore), Fort Rucker (ex-Fort Novosel) et Fort Gordon (ex-Fort Eisenhower), désormais attribués à d'autres militaires homonymes.
sources_note.en: Compiled from official U.S. Department of Defense and service websites (.mil, .edu), supplemented by Wikipedia. Renamed bases: in 2025 the U.S. Army restored the names Fort Bragg (ex-Fort Liberty), Fort Benning (ex-Fort Moore), Fort Rucker (ex-Fort Novosel) and Fort Gordon (ex-Fort Eisenhower), now honouring different service members with the same surnames.

description.fr: École d’infanterie du Marine Corps à Camp Pendleton ; son Advanced Infantry Training Battalion comprend la Reconnaissance Training Company, qui conduit le Basic Reconnaissance Course (MOS 0321).
description.en: Marine Corps infantry school at Camp Pendleton; its Advanced Infantry Training Battalion includes the Reconnaissance Training Company that runs the Basic Reconnaissance Course (MOS 0321).

issuers.name: Marine Corps Mountain Warfare Training Center
issuers.location: Pickel Meadow, près de Bridgeport, Californie

description.fr: Centre d’entraînement au combat en montagne du Marine Corps (MAGTF Training Command) : chefs de montagne d’été et d’hiver, grimpeurs d’assaut, éclaireurs skieurs, survie et médecine en montagne et grand froid.
description.en: Marine Corps mountain warfare training centre (MAGTF Training Command): summer and winter mountain leaders, assault climbers, scout skiers, mountain and cold-weather survival and medicine.

description.fr: Commandement des écoles de l’aéronavale à Pensacola, dont l’Aviation Rescue Swimmer School (six semaines) des nageurs sauveteurs d’hélicoptère de l’US Navy.
description.en: Naval aviation schools command at Pensacola, including the six-week Aviation Rescue Swimmer School for U.S. Navy helicopter rescue swimmers.

issuers.location: Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City, Caroline du Nord
issuers.location_en: Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City, North Carolina

description.fr: Centre de formation technique aéronautique de l’US Coast Guard : école « A » de 24 semaines des Aviation Survival Technicians, les nageurs sauveteurs d’hélicoptère des garde-côtes.
description.en: U.S. Coast Guard aviation technical training centre: 24-week “A” school of the Aviation Survival Technicians, the Coast Guard helicopter rescue swimmers.
